By now it was 1950 and the English middle distance scene was dominated by such 'greats[illegible] as Nankeville, Parlett, Eyre, and the young Bannister.

John Threshers club mile record has led a charmed life this year and, so it continued as John Gladwin, playing a supporting role in the Cram/Ovett head to head, recorded 4.02.24 for 8th place. So our first sub 4 is still up for grabs and we'll have to wait until next year to see who will be the 'Bannister of Belgrave'.
